raised: The page names פיקדונות and קרן כספית but never explains or compares them, and says nothing about the S&P 500
The cost table gives no shekel amount ('לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'), so the reader can't tell what the account costs
The '123 מקומת / מחושב / הזנה' colour key under the title is confusing
The basic/extended track line doesn't say what either track costs
The calculator defaults to a 5% return that a current account doesn't pay, so ₪74,044 makes the account look like it grows
'גיל (לא חובה)' and 'הצמדה: לא צמוד' meant nothing to the reader
The קרן כספית paragraph ('יחידות בקרן נפדות רק ביום מסחר') is hard to follow
שווה לדעת repeats מה זה, its codes (BANK-20 etc.) look internal, and 'מק"ם' isn't explained
'ריבית צמודה למדד: 25% מהריבית הריאלית' in מיסוי isn't understood
The code 'TXI OQ11' in the red מעוטי הכנסה box is meaningless
Worried that Israel has no deposit insurance and that a current account isn't covered by the proposed ₪250,000 protection
מה האתר לקח בחשבון (lock icons, 'חסום: שאלה פתוחה') reads like the site's internal notes
The pink 'מס' line in the chart is a thin sliver and hard to see
Confused why deposits show ₪62,681 rather than the ₪70,000 actually deposited
The 'מס ₪2,005' row is confusing when the account pays no interest
The 'חוקים וכללים' column is empty and 'הצגת החוקים והכללים' is unclear
Doesn't understand the 'בשקלים של העתיד' option
Can't find how much interest banks pay on a positive balance today
'Expenses of the month' is too vague a guide for how much to keep in the account, and there's no word on an emergency fund
Nothing on what exactly to say to the bank
Would drop the red box, מי מציע ומי מפקח, the איפה מופיע column, and shrink כסף נכנס ויוצא

problems.why: The reader only says they didn't understand the 'בשקלים של העתיד' label and left the toggle on the default, so they never claim that the figures in that mode ignore inflation and are wrong.
